points.direct_trigger: Frozen Core detects unchanged instruction progress at 50k-cycle checks, calls deadlock_check -> pipeline dump -> abort (SIGABRT); native natural telemetry closure missing is downstream symptom.
points.source_mechanism_confirmed: M4 atomic admission owns one OO PIB entry and external dependency. Frozen writeback_complete never marks zero-output atomic complete; callers decrement architectural atomic count but only call dtc_l1_m4_observe_complete if that boolean is true. The leaked external dependency prevents OO entry readiness/retirement. Actual frozen function+OO header fixture reproduces 128 leaked slots then admission refusal for both tag hash modes.
points.historical_cause_assessment: HIGH_CONFIDENCE_SOURCE_LOCALIZED_M4_ZERO_DEST_ATOMIC_LIFECYCLE_LEAK; historical exact OO occupancy and owner UIDs were not printed, so 128 live slots at the observed abort is an inference, not an observed fact.
excluded_as_direct_trigger: telemetry 8192/1M record cap: both end after only 7 records
outer RAM/disk guard: all captured samples pass; actual SIGABRT stack is Core deadlock_check
global atomic treated as cacheable mergeable load: decoder CACHE_GLOBAL and memory_cycle atomic branch exclude it
AE/XOR-specific defect: DM(AE0) and DH(AE1) same exact stopping state; CPU fixture fails identically with either hash mode
unknown: historical exact OO PIB entry inventory was not captured because existing diagnostic prints extra entry details only for PAPER_IO
minimal corrected lifecycle must handle split atomic responses and complete once, not every reply; no production fix or timing validation performed
barrier wait bitmap absent; other warps at pc0xEE0 is not by itself proof of an invalid source barrier
points.next_minimal_verification: Before any future simulator experiment, extend CPU source fixture with actual zero-dest atomic per-transaction completion aggregation, duplicate-completion guards, returning-atomic/no-dest RED/STORE/fence controls and full-PIB drain. A separate immutable diagnostic build could capture OO owner UID/operation/externaldep counts if later explicitly scheduled; preserve these historical failed attempts.
